summary: Newcastle Airport closed to non-scheduled traffic between 2300 and 0530 daily, while its controlled airspace remains active.
text:
AD CLSD TO NON-SCHEDULED TFC. NEWCASTLE CTA/CTR/ATZ REMAINS 
ACTIVE. OVERFLYING ACFT REQUIRING A CROSSING CLEARANCE SHOULD FILE A 
FLIGHTPLAN. ATS SHALL BE TACTICALLY MANAGED TO ACCOMMODATE PLANNED 
MOVEMENTS. BASED TFC OFF SCHEDULE WILL BE ACCEPTED.
